value.title: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

The Exchange has sought clarification from Oracle Financial Services Software Limited with respect to recent news item captioned OFSS shares fall 6.5% as report says Oracle's $18-billion data centre debt under pressure.  The response from…
Oracle Financial Services Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of 18,890 equity shares pursuant to the OFSS Stock Plan, 2014'.
